hooks.text: 白天营地经营包括制作弹药、精炼资源、扩建防线，并把工人分配到狩猎、搜刮或守卫岗位。
hooks.excerpt: Your camp is your last line of defense. Craft ammunition , refine resources , and expand your camp to strengthen your defenses. Manage your workers by assigning them to hunt, scavenge, or guard. Unlock merchants to buy new skills and traps, or use the watchtower for intel on the approaching waves.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 夜幕降临后敌群会从火光四周涌来，玩家需要改装枪械、解锁特性并释放能力守住最后火种。
hooks.excerpt: When night falls, they come. Hordes of relentless creatures, drawn to the light of your fire, rushing in from all sides. Armed with an arsenal of unique weapons, you must hold the line. Modify your guns , unlock perks , unleash devastating abilities , because if the fire dies… so do you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 外出搜刮前要权衡武器与弹药，而时间是最关键资源；若不能在夜幕前返回，营地可能只剩灰烬。
hooks.excerpt: Every expedition demands careful preparation - weapon selection and ammunition supplies play a crucial role in determining whether you'll succeed or fail... Above all, time is your most precious resource. Make sure to return to camp before nightfall, or risk having to rebuild the ashes that are left.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
